supply.source: CHAIN conditional source study, 2026-11-12; tools/chain/supply-study.mjs; hashes in docs/chain/supply-study.json; not C2 telemetry

assumptions.scope: Same1000-wallet cohort for5years, no arrivals, no churn, no new item utility. This optimistic retention stress isolates stock saturation; it is not a forecast.
assumptions.utility: Design hypotheses:75% casuals can save2 routine YARN by week13;50% can save10 by week26. Excludes grants and resale; only one feature and no other spending. Rename is unshipped; Epic source requires authority. No source establishes these exact thresholds.
assumptions.tail: Each of the last4 seasons must have at least1 aggregate YARN of routine claims and1 of burns. This deliberately weak liveness check is not proof of meaningful engagement. Zero/zero is not healthy activity.
assumptions.carry: Cumulative reviewed organic burn credit less paid routine claims; unused expired allocations can carry. The model settles all outstanding season promises before credit reuse. Production would have to subtract surviving signed and unpaid liabilities atomically.
assumptions.supply: Current-source conditional supply continues, with finite item stock. Real bot classification, preferences, willingness and source authority remain unmeasured.
assumptions.allocation: Unchanged shares.52-week model years,13-week quarters; post-cliff linear releases and each bucket ceiling. Distributor custody is not vesting enforcement. External unlocked tokens do not magically buy player items.
assumptions.authority: No production signer, deployment, fee change, entitlement change, or evidence of real demand.
